Manchester City v Fulham (Kick-off 12.30pm). Coverage of the top-flight match from Etihad Stadium. The hosts have dominated this fixture over the last 15 years or so and have an incredible record against the London club since 2009. Since a 3-1 victory for Fulham at this ground in April 2009 the hosts haven't lost against them in 26 meetings. The visitors have only picked up three points in that run and have lost 20 consecutive games against the North-West club.
